shortDescription: A framework for magical "entad" items: randomly rolled, rarity-scaled traits on weapons, apparel and furniture that reveal themselves through use, can be bound to a pawn's bloodline, and give durability, moods, abilities, damage effects and building bonuses.
body:
## Binding (EntadBinding.cs)
- An entad can be bound to one or more pawns (`CompEntad.Bind`, `EntadApi.Bind/Unbind/GetBoundPawns/TraitsActiveFor`, dev actions "Bind Entad to pawn" / "Unbind Entad"). Unbound = traits work for everyone (unchanged behaviour).
- A bound item works as an ordinary item for anyone; its traits only work, and only reveal, for a bound pawn or a descendant (bloodline via Parent relations, BFS depth 16, cached per pawn per item, last-asked fast path). Unbound items return before any lookup.
- Gated per user: wearer stat offsets, the item's own stats while held (weapon cooldown etc.), damage effects (melee caster / projectile launcher), granted abilities, equipped and furniture moods, table meal effects, furniture abilities, stat reveals. Item-level, always on: durability (incl. MaxHitPoints factors), market value, building properties, stats of an item nobody holds, a turret's gun.
- `bindOnFirstUse` trait field: binds to the first player-faction pawn that equips it or uses the furniture for itself (not during pawn generation). Planned for Persona; Dungeons will bind through the API at creation.
- Saved as references (dead pawns included, discarded ones filtered). `EntadBindingRegistry` (static, rebuilt on load) makes WorldPawnGC keep bound pawns and their descendants so the line isn't cut.
- Info: inspect "Bound to: …", info card "Bound to" row, and a note in the traits tooltip when the holder is outside the bloodline.

## Durability
- Every item with at least one entad trait gets its MaxHitPoints multiplied by `EntadSettings.Durability[highest trait rarity]`. Defaults: Common x1.25, Uncommon x1.5, Rare x2, Epic x3, Legendary x5, each adjustable 1–10. Applied last in `StatPart_Entad.TransformValue`, never hidden. No breakdown on the info card HP row (user decision).
- HP keeps its health fraction on trait add/remove, settings change and load (`SyncDurability` against saved `scaledDurability`).

## Furniture mood (EntadMoods.cs)
- Prefix on `Pawn_JobTracker.CleanupCurrentJob`, player-faction humanlikes. Counts work/recreation at the building, or own use (`IsOwnUse`: no workGiverDef, not mental state, denylist incl. attack/repair/refuel/haul/hack/carry/enter transporter or portal), when the job Succeeded or the pawn has stopped at the interaction cell or inside (not beds). Chairs, beds (CurrentBed incl. Lovin), eating tables.
- Stacking: `Thought_EntadFurniture` keyed by `thingIDNumber`; same source renews only if longer; at the cap the soonest-to-expire non-equipped memory is replaced only if outlasted. Equipped memories never displaced.

## Random mood traits (thoughtMoodRange)
- `MoodCandidates`: single visible-stage plain memories from all mods; no required traits/genes/hediffs, no gender, no minExpectation, adult-stage allowed, no chains or placeholders. False memories are intended. Multi-stage stays out.

## Localization
- All player-facing text keyed with `EF_` in `Languages/English/Keyed/EntadFramework.xml` (rarities incl. "Variable", properties, inspect, reveal, rename, card, binding, explanations, abilities, settings). Debug actions/logs stay English.

## Settings (EntadSettings.cs)
- Forge Frenzy layout: tabs General / Rarity and durability / Traits. Listing tabs in a scroll view with `maxOneColumn`. Traits list shows rarity, or "Variable" for traits that roll at several rarities. Reset at the bottom covers General + Rarity, not trait toggles.

## Save compatibility
- Removed duplicate traits map through `Patch_BackCompatibleDefName`; a trait re-rolls on load when its saved name differs or its stored value lists no longer line up with the def (e.g. Frostbite gaining extraDamage). Duplicates merge keeping higher rarity and reveal state.

## Planned: unique / persona weapon replacement (approved design)
1. New trait mechanics, gated by binding: burst count/speed multipliers, stopping power, ignore accuracy maluses, equipped hediffs, kill memory, reloadable ability (charges + vanilla reload job), `partialStats` flag.
2. Persona: trait with bindOnFirstUse, uses vanilla `bondedWeapon` slot (one persona per pawn), keeps vanilla equip lock, bonded hediffs/thoughts, Jealous via our own wield hook; patch ThoughtWorker_WeaponTraitBonded (NREs on non-bladelink bonded weapon).
3. Generate an EntadTraitDef per WeaponTraitDef at startup (commonality → rarity, exclusionTags → conflicts, values scale with rarity, call the def's Worker on equip/unequip/bond/kill).
4. Intercept creation of unique/persona defs (ThingMaker.MakeThing): swap to the plain def (strip `_Unique` / `Bladelink`; else keep def minus vanilla comp), make it an entad. Unique: weapon-specific traits only, forced Super quality, generated name inside entad markers (no colour). Persona: Persona trait + rolled traits. Sub-setting "exactly like vanilla": vanilla trait pool and counts. Settings default on, shown only with the DLC.

## Wearer stats, display hiding, startup
- Offsets via `StatWorker.StatOffsetFromGear` postfix; thread-static flags hide unrevealed traits from displays. Startup injectors patch each Harmony class in its own try/catch; reflection is null-safe.

## Weapons and content
- Extra damage via Projectile/Bullet Impact postfixes. Searing Burn 1–4 (Uncommon, scales); Cinderstrike Flame 4–10 (Epic); Frostbite 2–6 (Rare).

## Build setup
- net472, Krafs.Rimworld.Ref 1.6.4871 pinned, Lib.Harmony 2.4.1 compile-only; no publicizer. Debug actions live under the "Entad Framework" category (palette path `Entad Framework\Add specific Entad trait`).

## Open items
- Def hot-reload doesn't re-run the injectors.
- Lineage cache isn't invalidated if a mod adds parent relations mid-game (fixed on reload).
- Bindings and stage 1+ untested in-game (last test: run #15, build 41).
